notes: This file holds only public constants: an expected hash, a NitroFS path, a record stride and field offsets recovered from the decompiled BattleEnemyStatRecord.
No retail ROM bytes, names, stats or other data derived from the ROM are stored here.
Both the C and Java patchers read this through generated source, so the two builds cannot drift apart.
The record layout was validated by applying a mod profile to the user's own ROM and comparing the result against tools/make_data_profile.py, matching all 588 fields across 98 records exactly.
Mod content is not described here: multipliers live in mods/<id>/profile.json, so a mod is an ordinary data folder rather than a compiled-in plan.
